Chapter 622: Chapter 42 I’ve Waited Too Long (Please Subscribe)

“Emperor Xuanhuang?”

Lin Yuan looked surprised, having never considered this direction before, regardless of whether from Chikun Star Lord’s ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path or the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Secret Realm itself.

It was always ‘Mysterious Yellow’.

But ‘Emperor Xuanhuang’?

Lin Yuan had never thought in that direction.

“Yes,”

...

“Both Emperor and Xuanhuang, I guess you are referring to Emperor Xuanhuang,” said the Stone Statue Shen Ji with a nod.

“What is the origin of Emperor Xuanhuang?”

Lin Yuan immediately asked.

Whether it’s Emperor Xuanhuang or Emperor Xuan Huang,

both are Supreme Beings at the ultimate level, and no Supreme Being has been able to pinpoint the exact coordinates of the Mysterious Yellow Secret Realm to this day.

“Emperor Xuanhuang… that is a strong name occasionally known by my master from some cosmic relic; it is said that the lineage established by Emperor Xuanhuang was extremely famous eons ago, and Emperor Xuanhuang himself had progressed far in the ultimate domain…”

Stone Statue Shen Ji seemed to be lost in memory.

“Eons ago?” Lin Yuan pondered.

“Yes, in the era my master lived in, hardly anyone knew of ‘Emperor Xuanhuang,’ and he too knew only snippets about this Emperor from some relics.”

“In the end, Emperor Xuanhuang disappeared mysteriously, and his lineage declined. By the time my master rose to prominence, it was almost completely forgotten,” said the Stone Statue Shen Ji.

He was not a real life form but rather something akin to an Artifact Spirit, his mind filled with abundant memories instilled by the Moyu Tower Master, making him quite knowledgeable.

“Emperor Xuanhuang also disappeared mysteriously?”

Lin Yuan was slightly startled, as the Moyu Tower Master too had vanished suddenly, leading to the tower’s decline, and now Emperor Xuanhuang had met a similar fate.

“Do you know why the Moyu Tower Master suddenly disappeared?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment, then asked directly.

“Why my master disappeared…” Stone Statue Shen Ji fell silent for a while, “Now that you are a core member of my Demonic Jade Tower, you are entitled to know some matters.”

“Before my master disappeared, he once told me he wanted to go to a place…” Stone Statue Shen Ji said, shaking his head.

“And after that, he was gone,” said Stone Statue Shen Ji, his tone complex.

“To a place.” Lin Yuan’s mind rippled.

The Moyu Tower Master was most proficient in space; the Great Space Dao was vast and limitless, and a Ninth Rank being could comprehend the Complete Space Rules, but that was just a facet of the true space rules.

To completely transform the space rules into your own Great Space Dao was the domain of the Supreme Beings, and even within the same Great Space Dao, they were not alike, not even similar.

Undoubtedly, the Moyu Tower Master’s mastery in the field of space was terrifyingly high; for instance, just the creation of his Demon Jade Space could silently transport the World Tree and the Chaos Crystal to Lin Yuan in the Main Universe.

That was incredible.

To think that previously, Xia Qin Supreme Being had to specifically order his deputy Tower Master Nalan to run errands just to transport the Soul-Setting Pearl to Lin Yuan, and that was within the same universe.

From this alone, one could see that Xia Qin Supreme Being was inferior to the Moyu Tower Master in terms of space.

“Did Emperor Xuanhuang also go to this place?” Lin Yuan asked.

“That I do not know,” the Stone Statue Shen Ji shook his head, “My master did not leave any memories of that.”

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan did not inquire further. The disappearance of the Moyu Tower Master… that was too far-fetched for him at the moment.

Even knowing it, what then?

It was meaningless.

He might as well clarify the matter of the call from the core area of the Mysterious Yellow Secret Realm.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

An extremely subtle space fluctuation, following the magic jade mark, descended in front of Lin Yuan.

“Miniature Universe.”

Lin Yuan looked at the grayish sphere floating before his eyes, his gaze slightly fervent.

This was an entirely independent Miniature Universe outside the Main Universe, with its own Rule of Time.

Most importantly, this Miniature Universe could be refined by Lin Yuan, allowing him to observe the operation of the internal Rule of Time from its most fundamental aspect.

The Main Universe too had a Rule of Time, but Lin Yuan could only observe from the outside, whereas with this Miniature Universe, he could enter for closer observation.

The difference was significant.

“Refine it now.” Lin Yuan immediately began refining.

Several days later,

Lin Yuan had completely refined this Miniature Universe.

This treasure, specially provided by the Moyu Tower Master for members of his tower, left no hindrances, allowing Lin Yuan to refine it with ease.

Hum.

The moment he refined the Miniature Universe, Lin Yuan’s mind delved into it.

The vast spaces of rules like time, space, life, support pillars, and many fundamental rules, all were reflected in his mind.

All these rules formed a certain stable balance, jointly supporting the operation of this Miniature Universe.

“Is this a complete universe?” Lin Yuan was somewhat shocked, as he had also become a sort of Heavenly Dao in the Tianqing World, similar to beings before.

But Tianqing World was just a small world in the Boundless Void, how could it compare to a Miniature Universe? Moreover, when Lin Yuan became the Heavenly Dao of the Tianqing World, his strength was weak, and even if the essence of the Great Dao had been put before him, it wouldn’t have helped much.

But now, having refined this Miniature Universe, many rules were reflecting in his mind.

This Miniature Universe, though outwardly appearing as a half-meter sphere, contained spaces within it stretching hundreds of light-years, and even though it was far smaller than the Main Universe,
